items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: And we had a trombone player called Floyd Mike Miller. He used to play with the cattle band in Shreepo.

ctx.x: You remember any of his jokes or anything?

Huh? Well, I don't forgot all them old jokes. They was old funny jokes anyhow, you know. He tells a guy that he known. He'd be telling the chicken about, telling the people that he didn't like chicken very much, you know. And all that kind of stuff. He said, but he'd have one on the Sunday if he had to buy one. He must have been stealing them all the time. Yeah. He said, I don't have a chicken all the Sunday if I had to steal one. If I had to buy one. He said, but I don't like chicken very much. He said, I don't…
Before I forget it, I don't think we put on the tape in that hoodoo song. You say, I've been hoodooed by a big black coon.
